dialogues.jp: 「んー……やっぱ、しゃぶしゃぶですかね」
dialogues.en: "Well... I guess shabu-shabu is the best."
dialogues.text: "Well... I guess shabu-shabu is the best."

dialogues.jp:
何と言っても、待たなくていいのが素晴らしい。
さっとお湯に浸けるだけ。
dialogues.en:
The best thing about it is that I don't have to wait long. I
just have to put the ingredients in boiling water briefly.
dialogues.text:
The best thing about it is that I don't have to wait long. I
just have to put the ingredients in boiling water briefly.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「しゃぶしゃぶですか」
dialogues.en: "Shabu-shabu."
dialogues.text: "Shabu-shabu."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、今度作りますね」
dialogues.en: "Then I will make it next time."
dialogues.text: "Then I will make it next time."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「お願いします」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.jp: 出来れば、この冬のうちに……。
dialogues.en: If possible, before this winter is over......
dialogues.text: If possible, before this winter is over......

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あたしは石狩鍋がいいな」
dialogues.en: "I'm in the mood for sea food hot pot."
dialogues.text: "I'm in the mood for sea food hot pot."

dialogues.jp: 眞子が箸をくわえながら相好を崩す。
dialogues.en: Mako beams with joy, holding chopsticks in her mouth.
dialogues.text: Mako beams with joy, holding chopsticks in her mouth.

dialogues.jp: 「また、濃いのが好きだな……まぁ分かるが」
dialogues.en: "You like such thick tastes... I understand you, though."
dialogues.text: "You like such thick tastes... I understand you, though."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「でしょでしょ？　やっぱり鍋は北海道よ」
dialogues.en:
"Right, right? Speaking of hot pot, there's no place like
Hokkaido."
dialogues.text:
"Right, right? Speaking of hot pot, there's no place like
Hokkaido."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「いや、それは分からんが……だいたい、どう
　いう基準で？」
dialogues.en: "Well, I don't know about that... What's that based on?"
dialogues.text: "Well, I don't know about that... What's that based on?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あたしの主観的基準」
dialogues.en: "Based on my own subjective criteria."
dialogues.text: "Based on my own subjective criteria."

dialogues.jp: 実に良く、まとめられました。満点です。

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、最強は“鴨”の入った南蛮鍋よね」
dialogues.en: That's a most impressive answer. That's perfect.
dialogues.text: That's a most impressive answer. That's perfect.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「最強？」
dialogues.en: "Well, the best one is 'canard' hot pot."
dialogues.text: "Well, the best one is 'canard' hot pot."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「そう！　鴨に勝るものなんて無いわ！」
dialogues.en: "Right! There is nothing better than the taste of canard!"
dialogues.text: "Right! There is nothing better than the taste of canard!"

dialogues.jp: 手を握り締め、熱い叫び声をあげる。
dialogues.en: Clenching her fists, Mako gives out a passionate yell.
dialogues.text: Clenching her fists, Mako gives out a passionate yell.

dialogues.jp: （誰だよ、こいつ……）
dialogues.en: (Who the hell is she......?)
dialogues.text: (Who the hell is she......?)

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「鴨の前には、世界三大珍味も霞むわね」
dialogues.en:
"Even the world's three major food delicacies can't beat
canard."
dialogues.text:
"Even the world's three major food delicacies can't beat
canard."

dialogues.jp:
しまいには、キラキラ光る瞳からお星様が流れ
だしていた。
dialogues.en: By the end, she's got twinkling stars in her eyes.
dialogues.text: By the end, she's got twinkling stars in her eyes.

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく、眞子が萌先輩の妹なんだな、と再
認識出来た昼休みだったかも知れない。
dialogues.en:
This might be the lunch break in which I somehow realize
that Mako really is Moe-sempai's younger sister.
dialogues.text:
This might be the lunch break in which I somehow realize
that Mako really is Moe-sempai's younger sister.

dialogues.jp: ◆しゃぶしゃぶ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Shabu-shabu◆
dialogues.text: ◆Shabu-shabu◆

dialogues.jp: 俺はしゃぶしゃぶが好きなんだ。
dialogues.en: I love shabu-shabu.
dialogues.text: I love shabu-shabu.

dialogues.jp: が、眞子は石狩鍋や鴨南蛮が好きらしい。
dialogues.en: But Mako seems to like sea food hot pot and canard hot pot.
dialogues.text: But Mako seems to like sea food hot pot and canard hot pot.
